title: Persona Identity & Responsive Web

highlight.title: Human-Readable Personas
highlight.description: Launched subdomain-based URLs for context identities, moving from raw DIDs to user-friendly paths like /did/game.bika.

summary: This release standardizes persona profiles with human-readable URLs, hardens CNS name resolution for all human ID formats, and significantly improves the mobile experience for public profile viewers.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Standardized Persona URLs: Transitioned context profiles to subdomain-based paths (e.g., /did/game.bika).
Public Profile Responsiveness: Optimized header and card layouts for mobile and tablet viewports.
Credential Vault UX: Updated identity sharing logic to generate human-readable URLs by default.
Enhanced CNS Logic: Added robust handling for multi-word and single-word human ID resolution.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Hardened Persona Privacy: Fixed disclosure filtering to correctly apply user consent settings across all profiles.
AI Liveness Stability: Implemented robust JSON parsing for Gemini responses to handle markdown code fences.
Aligned Profile Identifiers: Corrected DID labels in profile views to show identity aliases instead of pending status.
Synchronized Data Schemas: Aligned frontend disclosure keys with backend database models for accurate field display.

title: OTP Pairing & Browser Extension Co-pilot

highlight.title: Secure OTP Pairing
highlight.description: Launched cross-device OTP pairing allowing browser extensions to sync identity without passkeys.

summary: This milestone release introduces a seamless OTP-based pairing flow for the browser extension, hardens security with cross-origin policies for extensions, and refines the Job Assistant UI by removing mock data and improving verified identity mapping.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Implemented secure 6-digit OTP pairing flow for browser extension authentication.
Streamlined Extension UX: Bypassed initial selection screen to navigate directly to CasperID login.
Enhanced CNS Name Resolution: Added smart suffix handling for .cid domain lookups.
Improved Extension Dashboard: Standardized data mapping for verified identities and CNS names.
Cleaned up Job Assistant UI: Removed mock data in favor of live platform detection placeholders.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Fixed CORS errors for `chrome-extension://` origins in the backend API.
Resolved "CasperID not found" errors by implementing normalized email and CNS lookups.
Restored missing user data fields (human_id, cns_name) in the OTP verification response.
Fixed session persistence issues between the extension popup and background scripts.

title: ImageKit Integration & Activity Log UX

highlight.title: Branded Loading UX & Cloud Media
highlight.description: Integrated ImageKit CDN with an animated branded loading ring for profile pictures.

summary: This update resolves avatar upload issues through ImageKit integration, enhances the Activity Log with relative dates and improved privacy, and hardens the deployment infrastructure.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Integrated ImageKit CDN for high-performance profile picture hosting.
Implemented an animated SVG loading ring in branded purple (#8652E2) for avatar uploads.
Standardized Activity Log with relative "Time-Ago" dates across the dashboard and log pages.
Refined Activity Log layout to show profile slugs (e.g. "lovi") and move visitor locations for better clarity.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Resolved 500 and "Missing File" errors during profile picture uploads in v7+ SDK.
Fixed WebAuthn RP_ID and Origin mismatches for stable localhost testing environment.
Enabled `trust proxy` in the backend for accurate visitor geolocation in production.
Updated GitHub Actions deployment workflow with ImageKit production secrets.

title: Identity & Infrastructure Scalability

highlight.title: Futuristic Liveness UI
highlight.description: Integrated an advanced AI-driven biometric verification flow with resilient retry logic.

summary: This release introduces a new high-fidelity mobile liveness experience, significantly optimizes landing page load times, and adds core infrastructure for careers and enterprise identity integrations.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Integrated futuristic Mobile Liveness UI with real-time AI status feedback.
Optimized landing page assets: Replaced heavy 7MB PNGs with WebP, saving 14MB in total load weight.
Enhanced PWA resilience: Increased Workbox pre-cache limit to 10MB to accommodate modern application bundles.
Launched Careers & Affiliate application engine with automated email notifications.
Implemented RSA-2048 signing foundation for upcoming enterprise identity features.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Vercel build failures caused by large asset pre-caching limits.
Updated passkey authentication flows for better mobile-to-desktop handoff stability.
Resolved QR code URL structure issues for improved mobile scanning reliability.
